title: Ymir Fritz and the Source of All Organic Matter
description: A slave girl in the Eldian tribe makes a pact with a spine-like creature beneath a great tree. She becomes the first titan — and the first of the Nine.

title: The Empire Built on Titan Power
description: Ymir's daughters inherit her flesh. Eldia conquers the continent with titan armies, and Marley is made a vassal for nearly two thousand years.

title: The Nine Turn on One Another
description: The empire splinters. Eight titans are claimed by Marley; the Founding Titan stays with the Fritz family and Karl Fritz chooses exile over victory.

title: The Walls Are Raised
description: Karl Fritz hardens thousands of Colossal Titans into three concentric walls on Paradis, erases the memory of the world and takes his people into a century of ignorance.

title: Fall of Wall Maria
description: The Colossal Titan breaches Shiganshina's outer gate; the Armored Titan breaks the inner gate. Carla Yeager is eaten as her son watches. Humanity loses a third of its land and population.

title: The Battle of Trost
description: A second breach. Eren Yeager transforms for the first time and, with the 104th and the Garrison, seals the gate with a boulder. Humanity's first victory over the titans.

title: The Female Titan and the Betrayal at Stohess
description: Annie Leonhart's infiltration ends in a crystallised tomb beneath the streets of the capital, and the Survey Corps learns that the enemy is human.

title: Utgard Castle and the Warriors' Reveal
description: Reiner Braun and Bertholdt Hoover admit they are the Armored and Colossal Titans. The Coordinate awakens, and the Survey Corps' war becomes a chase across the walls.

title: The Reiss Coup and the Coronation of Historia
description: The true history of the walls is dragged into the light. Historia Reiss shatters her father's titan and takes the throne; the Survey Corps stops being expendable.

title: Return to Shiganshina
description: The Beast, Armored and Colossal Titans meet the Survey Corps in the ruins of Eren's hometown. Erwin charges the Beast Titan; Armin inherits the Colossal; the basement opens.

title: The Ocean
description: The Survey Corps reaches the sea for the first time in a century of history. Eren points at the horizon and asks the question the archive has been building toward: if we kill them all, will we be free?

title: The Raid on Liberio
description: Eren attacks during Willy Tybur's declaration of war. The Beast Titan falls to Levi, the War Hammer is eaten, and Sasha Blouse dies on an airship over the sea.

title: The Paths and the Founding Titan
description: Eren reaches Ymir inside the Paths and asks for the power of the Founder. The walls crack open across Paradis.

title: The Rumbling
description: Tens of millions of Colossal Titans march across the world, flattening everything outside Paradis. Marley, the alliance and the Jaegerists converge on Fort Salta.

title: The Dawn
description: The alliance stops the Rumbling at the cost of nearly everything. Three years later, the survivors walk back into a world that will spend generations arguing about what was worth it.
